svg.aria-label: What happens over time in each of the four kinds of game. A stream has events every frame. A simulation steps steadily with occasional commands. An environment has triggers on entering areas. Turns resolve only after a move
svg.title: What happens over time in each of the four kinds of game. A stream has events every frame. A simulation steps steadily with occasional commands. An environment has triggers on entering areas. Turns resolve only after a move
svg.text: THE FOUR KINDS OF GAME OVER TIME
Each row is a strip of time. The marks show what changes the game and who caused the change.
input, movement, shots and collisions in every frame
steady steps, with each click applied as a command at one step
free movement, with triggers on areas and sight, and choices on use
nothing changes until the player moves
the world acts on the player
